name: CREB regulated transcription coactivator 1
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CRTC1 encodes CREB-regulated transcription coactivator 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and cAMP response element binding protein binding. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and protein homotetramerization.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Hidradenocarcinoma; Mucoepidermoid carcinoma of breast; Pulmonary mucoepidermoid carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
